native_seam.ownership: Record-consuming leaves require isle_actor_source_get to resolve the identical live canonical bound record, not a copy. Collision additionally uses isle_game_model_validate_binding to establish that this actual native model is the bound object's own attachment, then pure model placement/peek getters. Native camera overload uses camera_parameters only, never roll or computing fixed-matrix getters. Caller retains all native lifetimes and excludes concurrent mutation/removal; stale/recycled raw handles are forbidden by existing engine contracts.
native_seam.collision: Native root placement is the canonical AUX transform. RT and RTS are accepted; RT's existing canonical unit scale is used when flag1 consumes it. Disabled/missing AUX returns INVALID_STATE, with no identity invention. Root position/AUX scale are read only for flag1; root rotation/scale/node flags/matrix kinds/fixed caches never affect the calculation. Only the observed row3 is evaluated, not unused full concatenation rows.
native_seam.branch_order: Hidden and !tangible bypass all policy mutation and consumed numeric validation. Flag40 bypasses playerDist/collision/camera validation. Distance>10000 bypasses collision/camera. Point depth rejection bypasses X/Y; X-screen rejection bypasses Y arithmetic/cast. view_projection and view column3 are unused by point visibility. Species testing follows successful visibility publication, including clearing100 for a visible but disallowed species. Ownership guards always precede semantic bypasses.
native_seam.errors: All leaves are nonwaiting/allocation-free; no C wait/fault boundary. IsleGameResult propagates native ownership/argument/state errors. Consumed nonfinite point/view/distance, degenerate/nonfinite camera, overflow or out-of-int32 screen projection returns INVALID_ARGUMENT. Nonfinite/overflow canonical collision or absent AUX returns INVALID_STATE. Every error preserves all outputs and source flags. Nonfinite unconsumed branch fields are intentionally not validated. Signed32 projection is guarded at inclusive-2147483648/exclusive2147483648 before truncation, never clamped or mapped to invisible.
native_seam.camera_domain: Uses the existing native finite perspective domain:0<fovy<180,aspect>0,near>0,far>near,scale>0. Degenerate explicit look-at and fast-trig zero-sine/nonfinite results are explicit errors. No fixed16.16, GPU renderability, viewport, roll or renderer-budget checks. Finite negative playerDist retains source comparison semantics; consumed nonfinite distance is an explicit safe-domain error.
